scope: isolated app, synthetic notification and no personal content
finding: The production MainActivity requests only RECORD_AUDIO; no code path requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS, so on Android 13+ the notification capability stays unavailable until the user grants it in system settings
limitations: The permission request was issued by the isolated validation activity, not by the production flow
The notification carried synthetic text only
Notification delivery was checked in the active list; it was not confirmed visually in the shade
